description: This file defines the `ReviewerRatingDecorator` class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for the performance plugin. The class provides a decorator pattern implementation for the `ReviewerRating` entity, enabling additional behaviors or modifications without altering the original entity. It includes methods for constructing the decorator with a ReviewerRating object, retrieving that object, and setting a KPI by its ID.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ReviewerRating entity that adds methods for setting KPIs by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ReviewerRating entity.

methods.name: setKpiByKpiId
methods.description: Sets the KPI for the reviewer rating by its ID, retrieving the KPI entity via the entity manager reference.
